paragraphs.text: He has so sore afflicted me that men cannot judge my uprightness; for they judge only by outward signs.
paragraphs.label: a

paragraphs.text: However men judge me, yet will I not speak contrary to that which I have said, and so do wickedly in betraying the truth.
paragraphs.label: b
paragraphs.anchor: My lips shall not speak wickedness

paragraphs.text: Which condemns me as a wicked man, because the hand of God is on me.
paragraphs.label: c

paragraphs.text: I will not confess that God does thus punish me for my sins.
paragraphs.label: d

paragraphs.text: What advantage has the dissembler to gain, seeing he will lose his own soul?
paragraphs.label: f

paragraphs.text: That is, what God reserves for himself, and of which he gives not knowledge to all.
paragraphs.label: g

paragraphs.text: That is, these secret judgments of God and yet do not understand them.
paragraphs.label: h

paragraphs.text: Why do you then maintain this error?
paragraphs.label: i

paragraphs.text: Thus will God order the wicked, and punish him even to his posterity.
paragraphs.label: k
paragraphs.anchor: portion of a wicked man with

paragraphs.text: Which breeds in another man's possessions or garment, but is soon shaken out.
paragraphs.label: m

paragraphs.text: He means that the wicked tyrants will not have a quiet death, nor be buried honourably.
paragraphs.label: n
